evidence.text: This fictional laboratory reviews workload when theoretical queue-clearance time exceeds 8 hours and escalates when it exceeds 24 hours. Queue-clearance hours equal queued samples multiplied by processing minutes divided by available instruments and by 60. No instrument should be assumed to run faster than its configured capacity.

A count of zero available instruments must be handled as an outage in the source incident system and is rejected by this capacity model. Confirm maintenance windows and instrument availability before acting on a turnaround forecast.
